description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to shader qualifier types, including wrappers for qualifiers like invariant, layout, storage, precision, and memory, as well as a builder for parsing qualifier sequences.

classes.name: TQualifierWrapperBase
classes.description: Base class for qualifier wrappers, providing common interface for different qualifier types.

classes.name: TTypeQualifier
classes.description: Struct representing a set of qualifiers for a shader type.

classes.name: TTypeQualifierBuilder
classes.description: Class for building and validating sequences of qualifiers during parsing.

methods.name: JoinLayoutQualifiers
methods.description: Function to combine two layout qualifiers into a single qualifier.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the qualifier wrapper.

methods.name: getQualifierString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the qualifier.

methods.name: getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the qualifier, used for ordering.

methods.name: getQualifier
methods.description: Returns the specific qualifier enum value.

methods.name: getQualifier
methods.description: Returns the qualifier enum for storage or memory qualifiers.

methods.name: TTypeQualifier
methods.description: Constructor initializing all qualifiers and scope.

methods.name: appendQualifier
methods.description: Adds a qualifier to the sequence.

methods.name: checkSequenceIsValid
methods.description: Validates the sequence of qualifiers for correctness.

methods.name: getParameterTypeQualifier
methods.description: Builds a type qualifier for function parameters from the sequence.

methods.name: getVariableTypeQualifier
methods.description: Builds a type qualifier for variables from the sequence.
